title: Every … holds everything you can do
summary: The … on a recording, a file, a list row, a screen in your sidebar or a pane now holds everything you can do with that thing, nested as deep as it goes: your tools in their folders, Send to your AI with your saved actions or a message with a voice note, a video or a screen recording, and Make it into any of your formats. A tool or saved action added anywhere shows up in every … it fits, and a rule can hide any row for a file type, a time of day or a device.

payload.title: Point at any …
payload.body: This pane's … now has a row named after what it shows. Inside it: Send to your AI, with your saved actions in their folders and Write to your AI, a message box where you can type, talk, film yourself or record your screen, all without leaving the menu.

payload.title: A recording's … goes deeper
payload.body: Point at a recording here and open its …: every tool you can run on it sits in the folder you keep it in, then Send to your AI and Make it into a reel, a thread or any of your formats. Add a tool or a saved action anywhere and it shows up here by itself.
